changes: Lava rivers: a river vent's lava now runs as far as its flow takes it, kilometres if need be, instead of stopping at the edge of a fixed patch
Lava that reaches the sea quenches to obsidian on the sea floor and builds new land above the water
Running lava stays molten under its crust and cools once it stops
The starter world's youngest island has a lava river vent on its flank, on one face
